# `variant_explode`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
variant_explode(expr)
```

It separates a variant object/array into multiple rows containing its fields/elements. Its result schema is `struct<pos int, key string, value variant>`. `pos` is the position of the field/element in its parent object/array, and `value` is the field/element value. `key` is the field name when exploding a variant object, or is NULL when exploding a variant array. It ignores any input that is not a variant array/object, including SQL NULL, variant null, and any other variant values.

| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT * from variant_explode(parse_json('["hello", "world"]'));
```

Result:

```text
0	NULL	"hello"
1	NULL	"world"
```

```sql
SELECT * from variant_explode(input => parse_json('{"a": true, "b": 3.14}'));
```

Result:

```text
0	a	true
1	b	3.14
```
